evals.name: idle-reviewer-with-outstanding-iterate
evals.description: Recorded review-638/review-633 incident: an idle bare prompt still holds owed review work.
evals.prompt: Classify an idle review pane whose ITERATE verdict remains outstanding.

assertions.name: keep-blocked
assertions.description: Returns KEEP-blocked rather than treating idle as done.

assertions.name: reason-names-open-lane
assertions.description: Reason identifies outstanding or unknown lane work.

evals.name: task-done-with-untracked-artifact
evals.description: Recorded convention-audit incident: TASK_DONE was emitted while the whole skill directory was untracked.
evals.prompt: Classify a TASK_DONE pane whose Git evidence contains untracked files.

assertions.name: task-done-not-proof
assertions.description: Does not treat TASK_DONE as artifact proof.

evals.name: dead-process-under-live-title
evals.description: Recorded surface:241 and surface:222 incidents: a HOLD/review title survived a dead shell or exited Codex process.
evals.prompt: Classify titled panes whose process is verified dead.

assertions.name: title-not-liveness
assertions.description: Does not infer process liveness from the title.

assertions.name: process-field
assertions.description: Reports process alive=false distinctly from live idle.

evals.name: idle-pane-with-two-unpushed-commits
evals.description: Recorded surface:280 incident: an idle-looking pane held two commits not present upstream.
evals.prompt: Classify an idle pane with two verified unpushed commits.

evals.name: numeric-ref-retargets-live-worker
evals.description: Recorded surface:230 incident: after a close, the numeric ref silently resolved to a different live worker.
evals.prompt: Classify a row whose numeric ref resolves to a different stable UUID immediately before read.

assertions.name: no-disposition
assertions.description: Sets verdict to null and performs no pane read.

evals.name: clean-verified-closure-control
evals.description: Positive control: only fully verified closure may become a close candidate.
evals.prompt: Classify a live idle/done pane with no open lane, verified reporting, and clean pushed artifacts.

assertions.name: uuid-key
assertions.description: The stable surface UUID is the row key.
